'''2009 US West Nationals Day 2 Aaron Nelson LS Watch Your Step''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Aaron Nelson]] at [[2009 US West Nationals]] (Day 2).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Watch Your Step / This Place Can Be A Little Rough|Ref2-L-watchyourstep.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' WYS Again
* '''Username:''' airdog2003
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS17]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
